target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, PCI ARM64 graphical guest, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-xcaliber-current-after-scheduler.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-xcaliber
verified: X-Caliber left and right thrusters changed the ship; Space produced a visible projectile.
Escape returned to the graphical terminal, which accepted and executed 40+7 as 47.
The follow-on graphical terminal input and window-demo launch/stop smoke checks passed.
scope_note: This is QEMU acceptance after the current MessageScan scheduling regression. X-Caliber input/Escape succeeded in this emulated profile; it does not resolve or reproduce any failure seen in the visible UTM app window. No X-Caliber-specific Yield was added.
